== English errata comparison sources ==
The Decipher replacement names the eligible targets, limits the extra bounty-hunter deployment to yours, and uses defense value and total destiny with the vehicle modifier. The separately owned Reflections foil has its own verified words and a File. Only the two English Cloud City Limited states use this comparison.
